craft_notes: Sthāyin: Wonder at all-containing, marveled into refuge. Em-dash→comma + landing colon (ferment stated, hail released). Rejected: touching the moral — kept as T1/L0. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Foul aimed Godward ferments fine; fine elsewhere,
for elsewhere thou standest not so: hail, ho!
l4.sanskrit_cite: kukarmāpi yam uddiśya devaṃ syāt sukṛtaṃ param sukṛtasyāpi saukṛtyaṃ yato 'nyatra na so 'si bhoḥ

reads_against.argmap: Even evil deed aimed at which god would become supreme good. → Evil aimed at you becomes supreme; good is good only by you.
c1_essence: Flawless taproot sought by none; remembrance lucidity hymned.

l2.plain_english: Aim filth at him and it turns sterling; aim merit elsewhere — O, nowhere else such alchemy.
